Visible titles include: “Influence People”, “Small Business Big Money”, “Compound Effect”, “Zero to One”, “This Is Marketing”, “Seth Godin”, “How to Win Friends and Influence People” (partially), “Women Rise Up”, “Sell Like Crazy”, “The Millionaire Next Door”, “The 4-Hour Workweek” (partially), and others.

claims.claim: Mativational, business, relationship and self development books
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show multiple book covers matching motivational/business/relationship/self-development themes.

risks.risk: Exact number of books is unclear; price depends heavily on whether it’s a small bundle or a large bundle.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo laid out in rows with a visible count (or a video panning across all covers) and confirm total number of books.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a worst-case smaller bundle (fewer books) until the exact count is confirmed.

risks.risk: Condition is unknown beyond cover visibility (possible torn pages, water damage, missing pages, writing/highlights).
risks.proof: Request 2–3 close-up shots of the worst-looking pages: open to the middle of a book, show page edges, and show any stains/notes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/possibly imperfect condition (not “like new”) until condition is proven.

risks.risk: Editions/versions may differ; some titles may be different books with similar names, affecting value.
risks.proof: Request photos of the back cover or ISBN/author page for 3–5 representative titles (especially the highest-value ones).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used copies without premium editions until ISBN/edition is confirmed.

risks.risk: Some covers may be mismatched to the actual book contents (rare, but possible with bundles).
risks.proof: Request a short video showing the seller opening 2 books to the title/copyright page.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard used books (no guarantee of exact match) until verified.

proof_requests: How many books are included exactly? (Send a laid-out photo with count or a quick video showing all titles.)
Show condition: open 2–3 books to the middle pages and show page edges (no stains/torn pages).
Send ISBN/edition proof for 3–5 titles (back cover or copyright/ISBN page).
Confirm whether any books are missing, damaged, or heavily written/highlighted.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a mixed bundle of motivational/business/relationship/self-development books, but the exact quantity and condition (which drive the price) are not verifiable from the images provided.
